metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully added page numbers to the footer via Insert > Header and Footer > Footer > Default Page Style, then Insert > Field > Page Number.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can insert footer page numbers and enable/type text into the document header.
metadata.explanation: Chains two objectives: (1) add footer page numbers (checks PAGE field in footer XML, 0.5 pts) and (2) add non-empty header text (checks header XML files for any <w:t> text content, 0.5 pts). Initial state has no footer or header files in the docx zip, so both checks fail. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric functions from invalid 8-char suffix '2cd43011' to correct 32-char MD5 hash '5d6628525b72a5805637db6ac940e950' computed from '0e47de2a-32e0-456c-a366-8c607ef7a9d2|4']
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter function from 'get_writer_footer_and_header__2cd43011' to 'get_writer_footer_and_header__5d6628525b72a5805637db6ac940e950' (invalid 8-char MD5 -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 2: Renamed metric function from 'check_writer_footer_and_header__2cd43011' to 'check_writer_footer_and_header__5d6628525b72a5805637db6ac940e950' (invalid 8-char MD5 -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in task JSON to use new 32-char MD5 suffix

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts footer XML from the docx ZIP and checks for \bPAGE\b pattern, which reliably matches PAGE field instructions (<w:instrText> PAGE </w:instrText>) inserted via Insert > Field > Page Number.
Getter correctly extracts header XML and checks for non-empty <w:t> text content, verifying that a header with text was added.
Metric awards partial credit (0.5 per sub-goal) and correctly uses the result dict without misusing the expected parameter.
Postconfig saves the file via Ctrl+S before the getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.
Both instruction requirements (footer page numbers and header text) are covered by the evaluator checks.

Minor: Header check verifies non-empty text presence rather than verifying the text matches the document title specifically, but this is a reasonable proxy given the ambiguity of 'document title text'.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional: To be stricter about 'document title text', the getter could extract the document title from docProps/core.xml and compare it against the header text content.
